title: F16 WMMA support for native HIP GEMM
description: Add F16 dtype support using __builtin_amdgcn_wmma_f32_16x16x16_f16_w32 intrinsic. Template the kernel on element type (bf16 vs f16) and corresponding WMMA intrinsic. Coverage: 16 -> 17 shapes (unlocks small_f16).

title: GEMM kernel boundary handling + K-padding
description: Add runtime boundary checks to the 128x128 WMMA kernel so it handles arbitrary M, N (not multiples of 128) and arbitrary K (not multiples of 32 or 16). Edge tiles load zeros for OOB, K-padding zero-fills partial WMMA tiles. Grid uses ceil_div. No templates — one kernel with runtime guards. Remove alignment asserts from bench.cpp and skip logic from run.py. Coverage: 3 -> 14 of 17 test shapes.

title: Skinny-M GEMM kernels (16x128, 32x128 tiles)
description: Add separate kernel functions for small-M shapes: gemm_wmma_16x128 (2 warps, 64 threads, 5 WGs/CU) and gemm_wmma_32x128 (4 warps, 128 threads, 5 WGs/CU). Each has its own warp layout, load pattern, and launch bounds. Boundary handling from bd-20c built in. Dispatch: M<=16 -> 16x128, M<=32 -> 32x128, else 128x128. Coverage: 14 -> 16 shapes.

title: BLAS-like dispatch API for native HIP GEMM
description: Create a public C API (kernelgen_gemm.h) with kernelgen_gemm() and kernelgen_gemm_supported(). Stateless, no handle. Takes config struct (M,N,K,dtype,layout,alpha), device pointers, and HIP stream. Dispatch selects kernel by M-threshold, boundary handling is built in. Add --use-dispatch flag to bench.cpp.

title: Optimize native HIP GEMM kernel performance
description: Profile the native HIP GEMM kernel, identify bottlenecks, and iteratively optimize to improve TFLOPS. Document what worked and what didn't.
close_reason: Optimization complete, report updated with corrected clock analysis
